translation: Święty nigdy się nie myli. To musi być część jego planu…

source_text: I’m almost certain.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.I’m almost certain.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.I’m almost certain."

translation: Jestem prawie pewna.

source_text: Andrea? On the weekend?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Andrea? On the weekend?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Andrea? On the weekend?"

translation: Andrea? W weekend?

source_text: Paul? You saw Paul?

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Paul? You saw Paul?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Paul? You saw Paul?"

translation: Paula? Widziałaś Paula?

source_text: Miss Kimura. An officer and I confronted him at the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Miss Kimura. An officer and I confronted him at the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Miss Kimura. An officer and I confronted him at the mansion."

translation: Panno Kimura. Ja i drugi funkcjonariusz skonfrontowaliśmy go w rezydencji.

source_text: Why didn’t you call my office?

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Why didn’t you call my office?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Why didn’t you call my office?"

translation: Czemu nie zadzwoniłeś do mojego biura?

source_text: I…

structure.raw_value: McShOp.I…
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.I…"

translation: Ja…

source_text: I’m going to Channel 4 now. He’s not going to get away with this.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.I’m going to Channel 4 now. He’s not going to get away with this.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.I’m going to Channel 4 now. He’s not going to get away with this."

translation: Jadę teraz do Channel 4. Nie ujdzie mu to na sucho.

source_text: He was on public property. There was nothing we could do.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.He was on public property. There was nothing we could do.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.He was on public property. There was nothing we could do."

translation: Był na terenie publicznym. Nic nie mogliśmy zrobić.

source_text: He never touched the Wilkes property?

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.He never touched the Wilkes property?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.He never touched the Wilkes property?"

translation: Nie był na terenie posiadłości Wilkesów?

source_text: Well… Maybe a bit.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Well… Maybe a bit.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Well… Maybe a bit."

translation: Cóż… Może trochę.

source_text: This isn’t over. Meet us at the high-rise.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.This isn’t over. Meet us at the high-rise.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.This isn’t over. Meet us at the high-rise."

translation: To jeszcze nie koniec. Spotkaj się z nami w wieżowcu.

source_text: Shit. If Paul admits to being there with Kimberly it could lead back to me.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl^.Shit. If Paul admits to being there with Kimberly it could lead back to me.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl^.Shit. If Paul admits to being there with Kimberly it could lead back to me."

translation: Cholera. Jeśli Paul przyzna, że był tam z Kimberly, mogą dojść do mnie.
